newsitem.title: USA: D.C. board votes to close 11 schools.
newsitem.headline: D.C. board votes to close 11 schools.

text.p: An emergency school trustee board voted late Monday to close 11 public schools in the nation's capital, prompting angry and emotional reactions by many parents.

Five elementary schools also on a list of schools identified as old, crumbling or too close to other schools -- without regard for whether such schools were academically successful -- were spared by the board.
Angry parents charged the trustees chose to close schools primarily in poor neighborhoods.
